readout_other: ACE-III; ADAS-Cog; 12-item NPI; resting-state EEG (aperiodic slope, alpha); resting-state fMRI; diffusion MRI
direction_notes: Open-label: NPI scores improved and EEG aperiodic slope steepened after treatment; cognition (ACE-III, ADAS-Cog), MRI and standard EEG measures did not change.
safety_notes: One treatment-emergent adverse event related to the procedure (scalp irritation from head shaving and wig); one unrelated serious adverse event; the 2.6 MPa dose caused pain with flinching in all four Cohort 1 participants and was abandoned; participants sometimes heard sound.

timing.protocol_description: Scanning mode: 6-s sonications (10 ms pulses, 10 Hz PRF) moved across a 6 x 6 mm target grid, 30 sonications per session in Cohort 1 and 100 in Cohort 2; four sessions fortnightly. Started at 2.6 MPa free-field PNP, titrated to 1.95 MPa (all of Cohort 2 at 1.95 MPa).

exposures.label: SUS to bilateral lateral temporo-parietal association cortex (Cohort 2 only)

source_quotes.n_subjects: We conducted a human pilot study in 12 participants with AD with the primary objective of determining feasibility, safety and tolerability.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: With four treatment sessions spaced fortnightly, four participants received 30 sonications per session (precuneus, ∼30 cm<sup>3</sup> brain tissue) and the remaining 8 received 100 sonications per session (bilateral precuneus and temporo-parietal association cortex, ∼100 cm<sup>3</sup>).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The UltraThera<sup>Pilot</sup> handheld probe included the ultrasound transducer (H117, Sonic Concept Inc., USA) driven at 286 kHz by an arbitrary waveform generator (AFG31022, Tektronix, Inc., USA) via a 40 W 50 dB gain radio frequency amplifier (240L, Electronics and Innovation, LTD, USA) and an impedance-matching network (Sonic Concept Inc., USA), an inflatable coupling cone connected to a fluidics system and control electronics necessary to allow positioning of the probe to the participant.

source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: The initial 100% dose of 2.6 MPa in free field was associated with pain of sufficient severity to cause flinching in all four participants of Cohort 1 (three at the first treatment visit and one at the second visit).
